steps.code:
import random

# Parse the content to extract quotes (lines starting with " - ")
content = funny_note['content']
quotes = []
for line in content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove the leading "- " to get the quote text
        quote = line[2:].strip()
        quotes.append(quote)

# Pick a random quote
random_quote = random.choice(quotes)
print(random_quote)
